name: Yeo Zhi Yuan
headline: Data science and AI student at NUS. I fine-tune LLMs, build NLP and computer-vision pipelines, and find out why models fail. Now learning to build AI agents.
location: Singapore. On exchange at Tsinghua University, Beijing, until Jan 2027.

talent.text: I find out why a model fails and fix the cause, not the symptom.
I build whole ML pipelines: data generation, training, inference and evaluation.
I test claims with baselines, repeated seeds and confidence intervals.
I audit my own results: I caught a data leak and two benchmark shortcuts.

story.text: Began BSc Data Science and Analytics at NUS
AI research intern at CNB: fine-tuned a 7B LLM
